build_dataset_reader: build a tensorflow dataset reader that loads and parses GZIP-compressed TFRecords with segmentation masks
create_feature_descriptions: create feature descriptions for a tensorflow tf.Example with image and mask byte features
run_dataset_tfrecords: run the dataset function to read and parse a GZIP TFRecords file for a given dataset variant
test_dataset_variant: test the dataset function with different variants like train, six_objects, empty_room, or identical_color
review_decode_function: review the _decode function that parses tf.Example protos and decodes byte features to uint8 tensors
